 FC Bengaluru United and Sreenidi Deccan FC played out an entertaining 2-2 draw in their Indian Football League (IFL) 2026–27 encounter at the Bangalore Football Stadium in Bengaluru on Wednesday.
 Russian forward Marat Tareck opened the scoring for the host in the fifth minute before Lalromawia equalised for Sreenidi Deccan in the 27th minute.
 Colombian captain David Castaneda Munoz gave the visitor the lead just before the interval, but midfielder Ngangbam Naocha Singh, who was adjudged the Player of the Match, headed home a 49th-minute equaliser to ensure the host secured a point.
 With this result, FC Bengaluru United retained its fourth position on the table with five points from three matches, while Sreenidi Deccan FC moved into fifth place, also sitting on five points.
 Although the match began at a slow pace as both sides took their time to settle into a rhythm, FC Bengaluru United struck early to take a fifth-minute lead. Winger Lalramdinsanga Ralte danced past two defenders on the left flank and delivered an inviting cross into the box for Russian forward Marat Tareck, who produced a clinical header against the run of play.
 In the 49th minute, the Sreenidi Deccan defence switched off, and the host was quick to capitalise. Lalramdinsanga Ralte turned provider for the second time, delivering an excellent cross from the right flank to find Naocha Singh (in picture), who directed his header past the far post to beat goalkeeper Bhaskar Roy.
 | Photo Credit: 
 AIFF Media

Lalramdinsanga Ralte turned provider for the second time, delivering an excellent cross from the right flank to find Naocha Singh (in picture), who directed his header past the far post to beat goalkeeper Bhaskar Roy.
 | Photo Credit: 
 AIFF Media
 The visitor’s persistence paid off in the 27th minute following a defensive lapse from FC Bengaluru United. A false clearance fell kindly to Nishu Kumar, who swiftly provided an assist to Lalromawia. The midfielder made no mistake, calmly slotting the ball past goalkeeper Sangramjit Roy Chowdhury to level the scores.
 Sreenidi Deccan completely controlled the game after the equaliser, gaining all the momentum and launching a flurry of attacks.
 Its relentless attacking approach was rewarded in the 42nd minute with a beautifully worked team goal. Nishu Kumar delivered a sensational curling cross from the left flank that split the Bengaluru defence, allowing Colombian striker David Castaneda Munoz to confidently defeat his marker and bury a precise header past Sangramjit, sending Sreenidi Deccan into the interval with a deserved 2-1 cushion.
 The second half began in a completely different fashion as FC Bengaluru United responded immediately after the restart. In the 49th minute, the Sreenidi Deccan defence switched off, and the host was quick to capitalise. Lalramdinsanga Ralte turned provider for the second time, delivering an excellent cross from the right flank to find Naocha Singh, who directed his header past the far post to beat goalkeeper Bhaskar Roy.
 Heading into the final quarter, Mohanraj Nallappan’s FC Bengaluru United side—who also brought on Akshunna Tyagi for double-assist provider Lalramdinsanga Ralte in the 74th minute—adopted a passive approach to defend their point. Meanwhile, Sreenidi Deccan mounted immense pressure, introducing Hungarian forward Nicolas Fernando Morinigo Torres, Gurmukh Singh, and Lalbiakdika in the closing stages.
 Despite the late onslaught from the Deccan Warriors, the final few minutes did not produce any late drama, and the hard-fought encounter ended in a 2-2 stalemate as both sides shared the spoils.
